## EFX · E2E Test (manual, TEST script only)
Exercises the whole chain through the Router, one alias per node, an IF assertion after each, **stops at the first failure** and ends in *Summary* with PASS/FAIL per step.

**Before running:** (1) point `<<ROUTER_WORKFLOW_ID>>` at a Router whose HTTP node targets the **TEST** script; (2) the TEST script's Script Properties must have **`EMAIL_REDIRECT_ALL`** set (dbinns@team-group.com) — this run sends the real Initial Request / HR Verification emails; (3) replace `<<EXPECTED_ENV>>` (DEV) in *Test config*; optional `<<EXISTING_JR_TASK_ID>>` (an OPEN `jr_title` TK- id on the TEST sheet) enables steps 7b/7c.

Steps: 1 ping · 2 contracts (new_hire, id_setup present) · 3 create Initial Request (fixed payload, hireDate=today+14, `employeeType:'Direct Hire'` per r2 enum) → 5-digit internalEmployeeId · 4 getEmployeeId equals it · 5 getWorkflow checklist has "ID Setup" Pending · 6 submit ID Setup **without** internalEmployeeId · 6b re-submit expects an error (**optional**, reported as WARN) · 7 listTasks jr_title == 0 (the JR task only exists after IT Setup) · 7b/7c closeTask dryRun then closeJrTask on `<<EXISTING_JR_TASK_ID>>` if given · 8 assignSafetyTraining dryRun → expects `E_NOT_FOUND` unless `SAFETY_TRAINING_AT_SUBMIT=true` (then expects `dryRun:true`) · 9 events since start include our workflowId (`result` event).

**OPTIONAL steps 10–12** run only when `RUN_EXTENDED = true` in *Test config* (default false → SKIPPED): 10 createTerminationRequest (TERM_) · 10b submitTerminationApproval Approved · 11 createPositionChangeRequest (CHANGE_) · 11b submitPositionChangeApproval Approved · 12 listWorkflows since start contains our ids. The approvals check the **real session principal** (efx-bot) for HR/Admin — if it is not in `grp.forms.hr` / `CONFIG.ADMIN_EMAILS` on the TEST tier they report **WARN**, not FAIL. Approved terminations/changes create offboarding/change action items and send emails (redirected).

Every run leaves a `NEW_EMP_` workflow "EFX Test Hire<stamp>" (plus TERM_/CHANGE_ when extended) on the TEST sheet — cancel them from the dashboard afterwards (Summary lists them).
